international.title: UK inflation rises to 3.6% as energy prices increase
international.summary: October annual rate piles pressure on households as Iran war pushes up oil cost and rattles global economy Inflation in the UK rose to 3.6% in October amid an increase in energy prices triggered by the war in the Middle East. Figures from the Office for National Statistics show the headline rate of inflation as measured by the consumer prices index rose from 3.5% in September . City economists had forecast a reading of 3.6%. Continue reading...
